content.title: Ground Plex — On-Premises Data Plane
content.content:
The Ground Plex is SnapLogic's on-premises execution engine. It is the heart of the deployment for {{customer_name}} — the component that makes SnapLogic genuinely on-premises rather than cloud-first. Every pipeline execution, every data transformation, and every connector call happens inside the Ground Plex, inside {{customer_name}}'s private data center. The Ground Plex communicates with the SnapLogic Manager exclusively over a single outbound HTTPS connection (port 443). No inbound firewall rules. No data egress.

[IMAGE:assets/images/customer/airbus_vendor_profile/Screenshot 2026-04-27 at 21.19.05.png:Ground Plex Architecture and Deployment Model]

**Deployed as Docker containers on RedHat OpenShift**, managed via SnapLogic-certified Helm charts

**Each Ground Plex node runs multiple JCC (Java Cloud Connector) containers** — each capable of 100+ concurrent pipeline executions

**Active-active multi-node configuration for HA** — node failure causes automatic redistribution

**Stateless by design** — pipeline definitions and configuration are stored in the Manager, not on the node. New nodes are operational within minutes of deployment

**All connector credentials encrypted and stored locally** within the Ground Plex; never transmitted to SnapLogic cloud

**Fully streaming execution architecture** — Snaps process data as a stream rather than loading full datasets into memory, enabling high-throughput with predictable resource usage

[BOX:info]
**IMAGE: GROUND PLEX ARCHITECTURE DIAGRAM**

Insert: SnapLogic official Ground Plex on OpenShift architecture diagram showing JCC containers, Ground Plex node structure, and outbound HTTPS to Manager. Source from SnapLogic product/marketing team or use the SVG diagram above.
[/BOX]

**DEPLOYMENT SPECIFICATIONS**

**Container runtime**: Docker on RedHat OpenShift (Kubernetes)

**Resource requirements per node**:
- CPU: 8 cores minimum, 16 cores recommended for production
- Memory: 32GB minimum, 64GB recommended
- Storage: 100GB for logs and temporary processing files

**Scalability**: Horizontal scaling by adding Ground Plex nodes. Each node adds execution capacity. Typical production deployments: 2-4 nodes for redundancy and capacity.

**Network requirements**:
- Outbound HTTPS (port 443) to SnapLogic Manager (*.snaplogic.com)
- No inbound connections required
- Internal connectivity to {{customer_name}} data sources (SAP, Oracle, file systems, APIs)

**High Availability**: Active-active configuration across multiple nodes. Node failure triggers automatic redistribution of scheduled pipelines to remaining nodes. No single point of failure.

**Monitoring & Observability**:
- Real-time dashboard in SnapLogic Manager showing Ground Plex health, pipeline execution status, error rates
- Integration with Prometheus/Grafana for custom monitoring dashboards
- SNMP trap support for integration with {{customer_name}} enterprise monitoring tools
- Syslog export for centralized logging
